description: [QUARANTINED -- NOT RUNNABLE END-TO-END BY THE SCRIPT RUNNER. Do not read a failure of this script as an app defect.] EXCLUDED from the default sweep (run-winwright-tests.ps1 $excludedFromSweep): the runner SKIPS ww_wait and REJECTS ww_assert, so a Flutter dialog-settle boundary cannot be bridged. Symptom when run anyway via -TestName f56: a step succeeds, then the NEXT selector resolves 0 elements -- observed 2026-07-31 at ww_invoke Button[name='Save'] (the confirm dialog had not animated in yet). Selectors below are verified live and correct; the gap is runner settle, not the app. Reliable execution belongs in integration_test (F99). F56 create+delete safe sender lifecycle (Sprint 41 F97, round 2 fix 2026-06-14). Creates an Entire-Domain safe sender for 'winwright-test.com' (a non-existent domain chosen to avoid duplicate-check collision), confirms the save dialog, then uses the Manage Safe Senders search box to locate and delete the created pattern in a teardown testCase -- net DB change is zero. TEST DATA: 'winwright-test.com' verified absent from safe_senders table (count=0) at authoring time. Domain has TLD 'com' which is in kIanaTlds. Generated pattern: @(?:[a-z0-9-]+\.)*winwright-test\.com$ , type: entire_domain. DEFAULT TYPE: Entire Domain is the default selection on the Add Safe Sender screen (ManualRuleCreateScreen initState); SelectionItemPattern IsSelected=True confirmed via live UIA inspect -- no radio click needed. TLD type is not available for safe senders (only Entire Domain, Exact Domain, Exact Email). FIX 1 -- MAXIMIZE: ww_window_state maximize added as first step. Verified live: after maximize, Save Rule is IsOffscreen=False at y=654 (window 1020px+ tall). No ww_scroll step needed -- scroll caused a race condition in the runner (see block-rule script description). FIX 2 -- SAVE BUTTON INVOKE->CLICK: ww_invoke replaced with ww_click for Save Rule. CONFIRMATION DIALOG: 'Confirm Safe Sender' Alert with Button[name='Save'] -- verified live (NOT 'Save Rule', just 'Save'). TEARDOWN: search 'winwright-test' in Edit[name*='Search patterns'], click Button[name*='View safe sender details'], Delete x2 (first Delete opens 'Delete Safe Sender' confirm, second confirms), Back x2 to home -- all selectors verified live. INPUT FIELD: type=Edit[name='Enter email, domain, or URL'] -- same name in Entire-Domain mode on both block-rule and safe-sender create screens.

steps._comment: PRIMING QUERY (Flutter builds its semantics tree lazily ON QUERY, not on a timer) + maximize, so Save Rule is not below the fold.

F135 (Sprint 52): the account-picker step this script used to have is GONE -- the desktop default screen is now Review No Rule Items and Settings resolves its account lazily, opening straight onto the General tab.
PROOF OF ARRIVAL. Tabs project as Text nodes -> physical mouse path.

Entire Domain is the DEFAULT rule type, so no radio selection is needed here -- which is why this script never hit the selector problem that was misdiagnosed in the block-rule script (see F131 correction there).
Mouse path deliberately: ww_invoke reports success on an off-screen element WITHOUT pressing it.
PROOF OF EFFECT: the confirm dialog appears only if Save Rule actually fired.
